page: Amazon Web Services c9g.medium is a compute-optimized server instance featuring custom AWS Graviton processors built on the arm64 architecture. This instance provides 1 dedicated physical core and 1 vCPU running at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz. It is equipped with 2.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance operates on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

The c9g.medium instance does not include local NVMe SSD storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistent data. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard graphics processing units (GPUs), making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated workloads.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture and dedicated single-core configuration offer a low-overhead entry point for compute-focused workloads that do not require large memory footprints. The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio positions this instance for lightweight compute tasks, microservices, single-threaded utility scripts, and basic containerized applications.
